name: Thermal Comfort as Adaptive Prediction Error and Metabolic Regulation
short_description: Body generates thermal prediction from recent exposure; deviation produces thermal PE along comfort continuum; chronic thermoneutral exposure reduces metabolic flexibility
structural_pattern: The body generates a thermal prediction based on recent exposure history (hours to days), seasonal acclimatization (weeks), and contextual expectation (building type, outdoor conditions). Actual thermal experience is compared against this adaptive prediction. The deviation — thermal PE — determines comfort and behavioral response along a continuum: zero thermal PE → thermal neutrality; moderate thermal PE (localized warmth, cool breeze) → thermal delight; high thermal PE → discomfort; extreme thermal PE → thermal stress. Buildings that suppress ALL thermal variation narrow the adaptive prediction, reduce thermal tolerance, eliminate thermal delight, and may contribute to metabolic dysfunction through chronic thermal under-stimulation.
higher_order_principle: Goldilocks-zone PE applied to thermoregulation, with adaptive prediction replacing fixed setpoint. The inverted-U function from T2/L1 is instantiated in thermal experience, but the zero point shifts with recent history — computationally homologous to L2 (circadian PE).

adaptive_neutral_formula.example: At outdoor running mean of 25°C → T_n ≈ 25.6°C
adaptive_neutral_formula.note: PE is deviation from this adaptive neutral, not a fixed setpoint

positive_pe_alliesthesia.key_insight: Produces PLEASURE only when deviation is DIRECTIONALLY CORRECTIVE — cooling when prior state was warm, warming when prior state was cold

alliesthesia_principle.definition: Pleasure of thermal sensation depends on DIRECTION of deviation from prior state, not absolute temperature
alliesthesia_principle.example: Entering cool room from hot outdoors feels pleasurable; same cool room from cold outdoors feels unpleasant
alliesthesia_principle.pe_interpretation: Alliesthesia IS prediction error operating in the thermal domain

design_implications.strict_neutrality: Building maintaining strict thermal neutrality (deviation ≈ 0) eliminates thermal PE entirely — no discomfort but also no thermal pleasure
design_implications.thermal_diversity: Building with controlled thermal DRIFT or thermally diverse zones (cool stone corridor, warm wood-paneled library) creates opportunities for positive thermal PE at transitions
design_implications.naturally_ventilated: Naturally ventilated buildings → wider temperature range → wider adaptive prediction → greater thermal tolerance

calibration_parameters.calibration_source: Panel MAT-II (Doc 51) — de Dear thermal Goldilocks formalization

causal_links.evidence_base: de Dear & Brager (1998, 2002): comfort temperature tracks outdoor running mean. ASHRAE Standard 55 adaptive model formalizes this relationship.
Thermal PE = actual temp − adaptive prediction. Measured by thermal sensation votes and physiological indicators.
Heschong's phenomenological evidence + alliesthesia research (Cabanac, 1971): a stimulus that corrects homeostatic deviation is experienced as pleasant.
van Marken Lichtenbelt et al. (2009): chronic TNZ exposure → reduced BAT activity, reduced non-shivering thermogenesis, decreased insulin sensitivity.
Naturally ventilated buildings → wider temperature range → wider adaptive prediction → greater thermal tolerance (de Dear & Brager, 1998).

scope_conditions: Applies to all occupied buildings, most pronounced in extended-occupancy spaces
Adaptive prediction requires exposure duration — visitors have less adapted predictions than regular occupants
Metabolic benefits require repeated mild cold exposure over weeks
Radiant asymmetry enables thermal delight within a single space
moderators: Clothing: heavy clothing attenuates thermal PE magnitude
Activity level: metabolically active occupants generate internal heat
Perceived control: occupants with control tolerate wider ranges (Brager & de Dear, 2003)
Age: older adults have narrower thermoregulatory capacity
Season: adaptive prediction tracks outdoor running mean

interactions.nature: T29 captures chronic allostatic overload. MAT2 extends to capture chronic allostatic UNDERLOAD from thermal monotony.
MAT1 = contact temperature PE. MAT2 = ambient thermal PE. Both contribute to overall thermal experience.
L2 and MAT2 are structural analogs: both biological prediction systems that require periodic PE to maintain calibration.
